name: Minimum Star Number of the Three-Code Class
proof: Every coordinate is shattered, so every centre labeling has a centred one-star and $\mathrm S_{\min}\geq1$. At the centre $000$, no two-star exists because the other two class members differ from it on two coordinates. Hence $\mathrm S_{\min}=1$. The enumeration over all eight centre labelings is checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$.
